real_bugs.title: extra values of a local declaration are dropped (also in the old translation, not a regression)
real_bugs.reproducer: local x = f(), g()   -- AST: DefStmt x = f(); the call g() is absent, so pattern g() finds nothing

real_bugs.title: decimal integer literal beyond int64 becomes L Int None instead of a Float (Lua converts it to a float)
real_bugs.reproducer: local g = 10000000000000000000000  -- AST: L(Int(None)); expected L(Float 1e22)

real_bugs.title: hex integer literal wider than 64 bits gets L Int None (Lua wraps modulo 2^64)

behavior_changes_not_bugs.title: pattern -$X matches every positive integer literal (generic Generic_vs_generic equivalence -E vs n, now that integers are Int)
pattern "..." matches a variable whose constant-propagated value is x and 1 or 2 (generic constant propagation, same in Python)

old_parser_bugs_fixed: chained calls f "x" {..}, f(x)(y), f[[a]][[b]] were split into separate statements (~1300 calls)
method_decl pattern missing matches in multi-rule runs (old engine quirk)
